name: parabank_login
description: Log in with the given username and password and reach the Accounts Overview page

approved_plan.goal: Log in with the given username and password and reach the Accounts Overview page

steps.intent: Enter the username into the username input field
steps.action: Locate the username input field (e9) under the 'Customer Login' section and type the value of the 'username' parameter

steps.intent: Enter the password into the password input field
steps.action: Locate the password input field (e10) under the 'Customer Login' section and type the value of the 'password' parameter

steps.intent: Submit the login form to authenticate and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Click the 'Log In' button (e11) to submit the credentials

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to the ParaBank application

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to the ParaBank application

approved_plan.success_signal: The Accounts Overview page is displayed, showing a heading such as 'Accounts Overview' and the authenticated user's account summary table

hardening_rejected: s02_type: detector 'login_form_not_found' rejected: 'Customer Login' was on screen during the run that SUCCEEDED, so it cannot be evidence of failure

inputs.name: username
inputs.description: The username used to log in to the ParaBank application

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: The password used to log in to the ParaBank application

business_outcomes.description: The username or password supplied was not accepted by ParaBank; the user cannot be logged in.

then.message: ParaBank is not reachable at the configured URL. Verify the application is running and the URL is correct.

when.value: The username and password could not be verified.

then.message: Login rejected: the supplied username or password is incorrect.

when.value: An internal error has occurred and has been logged.

then.message: ParaBank reported an internal server error during login. Check application logs for details.

candidates.rationale: accessible role and name, most stable across restyling

success.description: Text the discovery model proved success with
